correctness.rationale: Exact subresultant elimination re-derives the primitive degree-10 secant polynomial from the published rational matrix. A separate standard-library verifier proves irreducibility mod 19 and an irreducible 7+3 factorization mod 17. Transitivity plus the resulting 7-cycle gives primitivity; Jordan gives A10; the mod-19 10-cycle is odd, so the Galois group is S10. The source independently certifies the same exact fiber as ten totally real secants.

value.rationale: The result supplies an explicit rational enumerative-geometry fiber where two strong behaviors coexist: all ten solutions are totally real while the arithmetic Galois action is still the full S10. This is a natural arithmetic refinement of the paper’s chosen base example and a reproducible benchmark distinguishing generic geometric monodromy from specialization arithmetic; it is not merely a recomputation of the published real count.
